column1: # RECOIL rejects every Game Boy Camera, GBTD/GBMB and NES file. No emulator or third-party render was available; evidence is the cited spec plus review by eye.

column4: GB Camera save (photo 1 of 2 slots); RECOIL does not support it. Slot and state-vector layout per Boichot's notes, tile encoding per Pan Docs; render reviewed by eye (circuit-board close-up), grey ramp assumed
